name: Show Affiliate Disclosure
author: S Abdullah Prem

sections.description:
The Show Affiliate Disclosure plugin adds an affiliate disclosure text to posts or pages with customizable placement options and multiple disclosure types. You can choose from predefined disclosure types such as affiliate links, sponsored content, or partnership disclosure, and decide where to display it: after the title, after the intro, in the middle of the content, or at the end. There is also a shortcode option available to place the disclosure anywhere manually.

Features:

  • Customizable disclosure text for affiliate, sponsored, and partnership content.
  • Multiple display positions: after title, after intro, middle of content, end of content, or via shortcode.
  • Simple settings page to modify the disclosure texts and choose the preferred position.
  • Use shortcode [affiliate_disclosure] to manually add the disclosure anywhere in your content.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/show-affiliate-disclosure directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Disclosure Manager to configure the plugin settings.
  4. Choose your preferred disclosure text and its position on the page.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the disclosure text?

Yes, you can customize the disclosure text for different types (affiliate, sponsored, partnership) in the plugin’s settings page.

How do I change where the disclosure appears?

You can choose from several options for where the disclosure appears, including after the title, after the intro, in the middle, or at the end of your content. You can also use a shortcode to place the disclosure manually wherever you’d like.

Can I use a shortcode to display the disclosure?

Yes, you can use the [affiliate_disclosure] – To Display the Affiliate Disclosure. [sponsored_disclosure] – To Displays the Sponsored Disclosure. [partnership_disclosure] – To Displays the Partnership Disclosure.

How can I change the font size of the disclosure text?

In the plugin’s settings page, you have the option to specify the font size for the disclosure text, allowing you to customize its appearance to match your site’s design.

Is there an option to italicize the disclosure text?

Yes, you can choose to italicize any disclosure texts by checking the option in the plugin’s settings page.
